components.name: Kanban
components.description: Board of columns whose cards drag between them, by pointer or keyboard (Space to lift, arrows to move within and across columns, Space to drop).

props.name: onColumnsChange
props.description: Gets the columns with the move applied.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Raw move, e.g. to save a card's new column.

props.name: onAddCard
props.description: Shows an "Add card" button at the foot of each column.

examples.title: Kanban · limit 3 on In progress
examples.code:
<Kanban
  columns={columns}
  onColumnsChange={setColumns}
  onAddCard={(columnId) => {
    setColumns((current) =>
      current.map((column) =>
        column.id === columnId
          ? {
              ...column,
              cards: [...column.cards, { id: `c${count}`, title: `New card ${count}` }],
            }
          : column
      )
    )
    setCount(count + 1)
  }}
/>
